expected.contracts: Implements and WithEvents enforce declared members and event hookup

expectations.notes: Let and Set choose value versus object assignment and honour default members, As New creates on first use, Implements dispatches through the interface and reports a missing member, and WithEvents delivers RaiseEvent to the sink -- including rewiring on a new source and disconnecting on Nothing, which had no execution test at all before. Class_Terminate is guaranteed to run: it used to hang on a finalizer alone, and since the CLR runs no pending finalizers at process exit, a measurement found it never ran at all -- not on Set x = Nothing, not at scope exit, not at program end. A weak register drains it at shutdown, newest first, and an object whose Class_Initialize failed is not registered because VB6 gives it no Terminate either. The timing is deliberately not claimed to match VB6: that needs a reference count, and half a reference count would fire Terminate on a live object.

activeXStockControls.description: Microsoft-redistributable VB6 stock controls. 'support' says how this compiler serves the control, not whether the OCX happens to be installed. A native-only control needs a registered x86 OCX; without it the host leaves a placeholder, which is visible rather than silently wrong. No entry here is oracle-verified: that would need a VB6 SP6 run.
